cells.items: extends, block/block.super, include with/only, partialdef, partial reference, load, custom libraries
cells.rule: Cycle/depth check; explicit exported context values; partial render uses same autoescape and permissions as parent.

cells.items: if/elif/else, for/empty, ifchanged, with, cycle/resetcycle, regroup, firstof, filter, comment, verbatim
cells.rule: Missing values render empty unless strict mode; no arbitrary reflection method calls or executable Go expressions.

cells.items: autoescape, csrf_token, debug, lorem, now, spaceless, templatetag, url, querystring, widthratio
cells.rule: debug disabled in production; CSRF token comes from request context; URL reversing uses named routes; querystring copies/encodes multivalue params.

cells.items: addslashes, capfirst, center, cut, escape/force_escape/escapeseq, fix_ampersands, iriencode, join, linebreaks/linebreaksbr, linenumbers, ljust/rjust, lower/upper, slugify, stringformat, striptags, title, truncatechars/words/html, wordcount/wordwrap
cells.rule: Escaping tracks SafeHTML provenance; striptags is text presentation, not an HTML sanitizer; truncate HTML parses structure before output.
